claim: The sample catalogue is filled in one click, resets, and saves nothing.
sandbox: fresh phone browser context; six real catalogue rows; change search, reset, leave demo; assert empty browser storage and same-origin requests

claim: Catalogue search stays in your browser.
sandbox: fresh catalogue; enter a unique product slug; assert the term is not sent in any request and the visible results change

claim: No account is needed to browse.
sandbox: fresh catalogue; filter games and open a product detail page; assert no sign-in wall or password field
fresh catalogue; assert the browse path has no checkout UI and makes no payment or billing request

claim: Hello Factory sets no cookies, stores no search history, and runs no analytics.
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit privacy and catalogue routes; assert cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, and third-party requests remain empty

claim: The guide sends entered words to Sociobot only after Ask the guide is chosen.
sandbox: intercept the recommendation endpoint; enter a query; assert no call before the button and exactly one matching POST after it

claim: QA badges show the controller verdict and recorded date.
where: catalogue cards, product detail pages, terms page
sandbox: open released, verifying, and polishing product pages; assert distinct verdict text and exact controller dates or an honest missing-date message

claim: Catalogue totals, game membership, recent-release membership, defaults, and QA states match the controller snapshot.
where: landing counts and shelves, catalogue filters, product pages
sandbox: load the published JSON and compare its count with the first screen, Games shelf and filter, Just released QA badges, and an uncurated product page

claim: Product pictures come from the controller snapshot and remain local to Hello Factory.
sandbox: normalize the tracked controller snapshot; assert each supplied image becomes the matching local product and detail image path
